title: ObservationBatch
description: Mode C. Typed observations derived from source rows or change events, batched for sealing and for the discrepancy pipeline. An observation is a STATEMENT ABOUT THE SOURCE, not a claim: it becomes a claim only in authoritative mode, through the server's ordinary ProposeClaim gate.

mapping.description: `name@version` of the ClaimMapping that produced these.

sealed_evidence_id.description: Set once the batch is sealed. The discrepancy finding cites this plus the ledger claim id — both sides of the disagreement.

entity_candidates.description: Resolved candidates with confidence, best first. AMBIGUITY IS NOT RESOLVED HERE: two candidates above the threshold means the pipeline files `identity_ambiguous` and merges nothing.

valid_time.description: When the fact is true in the world, per the mapping's declared column.

transaction_time.description: When the SOURCE recorded it (LSN, delta_version, observed_at). Bitemporality is the reason a backdated update is reviewable instead of silently overwriting.

change_kind.description: CLOSED. What the source did. `backdated` is deliberately its own kind: it never becomes a correction without review.

origin.description: Exactly the block that lands on a proposed claim in authoritative mode.

row_key.description: The source's stable primary key, encoded.

event_position.description: LSN / delta_version / manifest offset — what makes replay idempotent.
